source_refs.note: Exercise 14.3, Question 5: a and b such that u x v = 0 (book p.283). Answer key PDF 312: a = 21/5, b = 12/5.

blocks.prompt: 5. If the cross product of the vectors \(\underline{u} = 7\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 5\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{v} = a\underline{i} - b\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\) is zero, then find the values of \(a\) and \(b\).
blocks.explanation:
Cross product zero ka matlab hai ke dono vectors parallel (ek hi line mein) hain.
Humein do unknowns \(a\) aur \(b\) chahiye.
Plan: letters ke saath hi \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) nikalein, har component ko zero ke barabar rakhein, solve karein, aur teesre component se tasdeeq karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{u} = 7\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 5\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = a\underline{i} - b\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), aur \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \underline{0}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(a\) aur \(b\).
Tareeqa: Koi vector tabhi zero vector hota hai jab us ke teenon components zero hon. Is liye determinant formula se \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) likhenge aur har component ko 0 ke barabar rakhenge. Do unknowns hain aur teen equations milengi; teesri equation check ka kaam degi.

Determinant likhein
\[\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 7 & -4 & 5 \\ a & -b & 3 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Row 2 mein \(\underline{u}\) ke components \(7, -4, 5\) aur row 3 mein \(\underline{v}\) ke \(a, -b, 3\).
Dhyan dein: \(\underline{v}\) mein \(-b\underline{j}\) hai, is liye \(\underline{j}\) ka component \(-b\) hai, \(b\) nahi. Yeh minus bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

Minors nikalein
\[\underline{i}\text{ minor} = (-4)(3) - (5)(-b)\]
\[= -12 + 5b\]
\[\underline{j}\text{ minor} = (7)(3) - (5)(a)\]
\[= 21 - 5a\]
\[\underline{k}\text{ minor} = (7)(-b) - (-4)(a)\]
\[= -7b + 4a\]
Kyun: Har unit vector ki row aur column dhak kar 2 by 2 ka hisaab. Letters ko bhi numbers ki tarah hi multiply karte hain; \((5)(-b) = -5b\) ko minus karne se \(+5b\) bana.

Signs \(+, -, +\) lagayein
\[\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = (5b - 12)\underline{i} - (21 - 5a)\underline{j}\]
\[+ (4a - 7b)\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{j}\) wala term minus ho kar aata hai, is liye \(-(21 - 5a)\underline{j}\).

Har component ko zero rakhein
\[5b - 12 = 0 \Rightarrow b = \dfrac{12}{5}\]
\[21 - 5a = 0 \Rightarrow a = \dfrac{21}{5}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \underline{0}\) ka matlab hai \(\underline{i}\) wala hissa bhi zero aur \(\underline{j}\) wala bhi. Pehli equation mein sirf \(b\) hai aur doosri mein sirf \(a\), is liye dono seedhe solve ho gaye.

\(\underline{k}\) component se tasdeeq
\[4a - 7b = 4\left(\dfrac{21}{5}\right) - 7\left(\dfrac{12}{5}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{84}{5} - \dfrac{84}{5} = 0\]
Kyun: Teesra component bhi zero hona chahiye; values rakhne par zero aaya, yani jawab sahi hai. Agar yahan zero na aata to iska matlab hota ke aisi \(a, b\) mumkin hi nahi.

Doosre tareeqe se tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{a}{7} = \dfrac{-b}{-4} = \dfrac{3}{5}\]
Kyun: Cross product zero ho to vectors parallel hote hain, yani \(\underline{v} = \tfrac{3}{5}\underline{u}\) (\(\underline{k}\) ke components \(3\) aur \(5\) ka ratio). Is se \(a = \tfrac{3}{5}(7) = \tfrac{21}{5}\) aur \(-b = \tfrac{3}{5}(-4)\), yani \(b = \tfrac{12}{5}\). Dono tareeqe ek hi jawab dete hain.
